versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י הַגּוֹרָ֗ל לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אֶל־גְּב֨וּל אֱד֧וֹם מִדְבַּר־צִ֛ן נֶ֖גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֥ה תֵימָֽן׃

controles.web: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
controles.kjv: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
controles.livre: E foi a sorte da tribo dos filhos de Judá, por suas famílias, junto ao termo de Edom, do deserto de Zim ao sul, ao lado do sul.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֖ה יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁ֖ן הַפֹּנֶ֥ה נֶֽגְבָּה׃

controles.web: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;
controles.kjv: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
controles.livre: E seu termo da parte do sul foi desde a costa do mar Salgado, desde a baía que está voltada ao sul;

versos.hebraico: וְ֠יָצָא אֶל־מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה וְעָלָ֥ה מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְעָבַ֤ר חֶצְרוֹן֙ וְעָלָ֣ה אַדָּ֔רָה וְנָסַ֖ב הַקַּרְקָֽעָה׃

controles.web: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned about to Karka;
controles.kjv: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh–acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh–barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
controles.livre: E saía até o sul à subida de Acrabim, passando até Zim; e subindo pelo sul até Cades-Barneia, passava a Hebrom, e subindo por Adar dava volta a Carca;

versos.hebraico: וְעָבַ֣ר עַצְמ֗וֹנָה וְיָצָא֙ נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֔יִם והיה תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָ֑מָּה זֶה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃

controles.web: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.
controles.kjv: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
controles.livre: De ali passava a Azmom, e saía ao ribeiro do Egito; e sai este termo ao ocidente. Este pois vos será o termo do sul.

versos.hebraico: וּגְב֥וּל קֵ֨דְמָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח עַד־קְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וּגְב֞וּל לִפְאַ֤ת צָפ֨וֹנָה֙ מִלְּשׁ֣וֹן הַיָּ֔ם מִקְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

controles.web: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.
controles.kjv: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
controles.livre: O termo do oriente é o mar Salgado até o fim do Jordão. E o termo da parte do norte, desde a baía do mar, desde o fim do Jordão:

versos.hebraico: וְעָלָ֤ה הַגְּבוּל֙ בֵּ֣ית חָגְלָ֔ה וְעָבַ֕ר מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְבֵ֣ית הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּב֔וּל אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵֽן׃

controles.web: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
controles.kjv: And the border went up to Beth–hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
controles.livre: E sobe este termo por Bete-Hogla, e passa do norte a Bete-Arabá, e daqui sobe este termo à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben.

versos.hebraico: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֥וּל׀ דְּבִרָה֮ מֵעֵ֣מֶק עָכוֹר֒ וְצָפ֜וֹנָה פֹּנֶ֣ה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל אֲשֶׁר־נֹ֨כַח֙ לְמַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַנָּ֑חַל וְעָבַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־מֵי־עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו אֶל־עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃

controles.web: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is over against the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
controles.kjv: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En–shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En–rogel:
controles.livre: E torna a subir este termo a Debir desde o vale de Acor: e ao norte olha sobre Gilgal, que está diante da subida de Adumim, a qual está ao sul do ribeiro: e passa este termo às águas de En-Semes, e sai à fonte de Rogel:

versos.hebraico: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל גֵּ֣י בֶן־הִנֹּ֗ם אֶל־כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב הִ֖יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵ֤י גֵֽי־הִנֹּם֙ יָ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה עֵֽמֶק־רְפָאִ֖ים צָפֹֽנָה׃

controles.web: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite southward (the same is Jerusalem); and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.
controles.kjv: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
controles.livre: E sobe este termo pelo vale do filho de Hinom ao lado dos jebuseus ao sul: esta é Jerusalém. Logo sobe este termo pelo cume do monte que está diante do vale de Hinom até o ocidente, o qual está ao fim do vale dos gigantes ao norte;

versos.hebraico: וְתָאַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל מֵרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֶל־מַעְיַן֙ מֵ֣י נֶפְתּ֔וֹחַ וְיָצָ֖א אֶל־עָרֵ֣י הַר־עֶפְר֑וֹן וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔ה הִ֖יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃

controles.web: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (the same is Kiriath Jearim);
controles.kjv: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath–jearim:
controles.livre: E rodeia este termo desde o cume do monte até a fonte das águas de Neftoa, e sai às cidades do monte de Efrom, rodeando logo o mesmo termo a Baalá, a qual é Quriate-Jearim.

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַב֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִבַּעֲלָ֥ה יָ֨מָּה֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעָבַ֕ר אֶל־כֶּ֧תֶף הַר־יְעָרִ֛ים מִצָּפ֖וֹנָה הִ֣יא כְסָל֑וֹן וְיָרַ֥ד בֵּֽית־שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְעָבַ֥ר תִּמְנָֽה׃

controles.web: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim on the north (the same is Chesalon), and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;
controles.kjv: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth–shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
controles.livre: Depois torna este termo desde Baalá até o ocidente ao monte de Seir: e passa ao lado do monte de Jearim até o norte, esta é Quesalom, e desce a Bete-Semes, e passa a Timna.

versos.hebraico: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־כֶּ֣תֶף עֶקְרוֹן֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ שִׁכְּר֔וֹנָה וְעָבַ֥ר הַר־הַֽבַּעֲלָ֖ה וְיָצָ֣א יַבְנְאֵ֑ל וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָֽמָּה׃

controles.web: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
controles.kjv: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
controles.livre: Sai logo este termo ao lado de Ecrom até o norte; e rodeia o mesmo termo a Sicrom, e passa pelo monte de Baalá, e sai a Jabneel: e sai este termo ao mar.

versos.hebraico: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם הַיָּ֥מָּה הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶ֠ה גְּב֧וּל בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֛ה סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.
controles.kjv: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
controles.livre: O termo do ocidente é o mar grande. Este, pois, é o termo dos filhos de Judá em derredor, por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וּלְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֗ה נָ֤תַן חֵ֨לֶק֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת־קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע אֲבִ֥י הָעֲנָ֖ק הִ֥יא חֶבְרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: To Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (the same is Hebron).
controles.kjv: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
controles.livre: Mas a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, deu parte entre os filhos de Judá, conforme o mandamento do SENHOR a Josué: isto é, a Quiriate-Arba, do pai de Anaque, que é Hebrom.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤רֶשׁ מִשָּׁם֙ כָּלֵ֔ב אֶת־שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הָעֲנָ֑ק אֶת־שֵׁשַׁ֤י וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן֙ וְאֶת־תַּלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָֽק׃

controles.web: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
controles.kjv: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
controles.livre: E Calebe expulsou dali três filhos de Anaque, a Sesai, Aimã, e Talmai, filhos de Anaque.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַל מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑ר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִ֥ר לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת־סֵֽפֶר׃

controles.web: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.
controles.kjv: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher.
controles.livre: De aqui subiu aos que moravam em Debir: e o nome de Debir era antes Quiriate-Sefer.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵ֖פֶר וּלְכָדָ֑הּ וְנָתַ֥תִּי ל֛וֹ אֶת־עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter as wife.”
controles.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
controles.livre: E disse Calebe: Ao que ferir a Quiriate-Sefer, e a tomar, eu lhe darei a minha filha Acsa por mulher.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֛הּ עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־קְנַ֖ז אֲחִ֣י כָלֵ֑ב וַיִּתֶּן־ל֛וֹ אֶת־עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
controles.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
controles.livre: E tomou-a Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão de Calebe; e ele lhe deu por mulher a sua filha Acsa.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֨הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽאֵת־אָבִ֨יהָ֙ שָׂדֶ֔ה וַתִּצְנַ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל הַחֲמ֑וֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר־לָ֥הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה־לָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off of her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
controles.livre: E aconteceu que quando a levava, ele a persuadiu que pedisse a seu pai terras para lavrar. Ela então desceu do asno. E Calebe lhe disse: Que tens?

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר תְּנָה־לִּ֣י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַנֶּ֨גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔נִי וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָ֗הּ אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּיּ֔וֹת וְאֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.”   He gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
controles.kjv: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
controles.livre: E ela respondeu: Dá-me bênção; pois me deste terra de secura, dá-me também fontes de águas. Ele então lhe deu as fontes de acima, e as de abaixo.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
controles.kjv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
controles.livre: Esta, pois é a herança das tribos dos filhos de Judá por suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ הֶעָרִ֗ים מִקְצֵה֙ לְמַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־גְּב֥וּל אֱד֖וֹם בַּנֶּ֑גְבָּה קַבְצְאֵ֥ל וְעֵ֖דֶר וְיָגֽוּר׃

controles.web: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
controles.kjv: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
controles.livre: E foram as cidades do termo da tribo dos filhos de Judá até o termo de Edom ao sul: Cabzeel, e Éder, e Jagur,

versos.hebraico: וְקִינָ֥ה וְדִֽימוֹנָ֖ה וְעַדְעָדָֽה׃

controles.web: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
controles.kjv: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
controles.livre: E Quiná, e Dimona, e Adada,

versos.hebraico: וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְחָצ֖וֹר וְיִתְנָֽן׃

controles.web: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
controles.kjv: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
controles.livre: E Quedes, e Hazor, e Itnã,

versos.hebraico: זִ֥יף וָטֶ֖לֶם וּבְעָלֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
controles.kjv: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
controles.livre: Zife, e Telém, Bealote,

versos.hebraico: וְחָצ֤וֹר׀ חֲדַתָּה֙ וּקְרִיּ֔וֹת חֶצְר֖וֹן הִ֥יא חָצֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (the same is Hazor),
controles.kjv: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
controles.livre: E Hazor-Hadata, e Queriote-Hezrom, que é Hazor,

versos.hebraico: אֲמָ֥ם וּשְׁמַ֖ע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃

controles.web: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
controles.kjv: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
controles.livre: Amã, e Sema, e Moladá,

versos.hebraico: וַחֲצַ֥ר גַּדָּ֛ה וְחֶשְׁמ֖וֹן וּבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט׃

controles.web: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
controles.kjv: And Hazar–gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth–palet,
controles.livre: E Hazar-Gada, e Hesmom, e Bete-Pelete,

versos.hebraico: וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּבִזְיוֹתְיָֽה׃

controles.web: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
controles.kjv: And Hazar–shual, and Beer–sheba, and Bizjothjah,
controles.livre: E Hazar-Sual, Berseba, e Biziotiá,

versos.hebraico: בַּעֲלָ֥ה וְעִיִּ֖ים וָעָֽצֶם׃

controles.web: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
controles.kjv: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
controles.livre: Baalá, e Iim, e Azém,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּכְסִ֖יל וְחָרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
controles.kjv: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
controles.livre: E Eltolade, e Quesil, e Hormá,

versos.hebraico: וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּמַדְמַנָּ֖ה וְסַנְסַנָּֽה׃

controles.web: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
controles.kjv: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
controles.livre: E Ziclague, e Madmana, Sansana,

versos.hebraico: וּלְבָא֥וֹת וְשִׁלְחִ֖ים וְעַ֣יִן וְרִמּ֑וֹן כָּל־עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וָתֵ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

controles.web: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
controles.livre: E Lebaote, Silim, e Aim, e Rimom; em todas vinte e nove cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֑ה אֶשְׁתָּא֥וֹל וְצָרְעָ֖ה וְאַשְׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
controles.kjv: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
controles.livre: Nas planícies, Estaol, e Zorá, e Asná,

versos.hebraico: וְזָנ֨וֹחַ֙ וְעֵ֣ין גַּנִּ֔ים תַּפּ֖וּחַ וְהָעֵינָֽם׃

controles.web: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
controles.kjv: And Zanoah, and En–gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
controles.livre: E Zanoa, e En-Ganim, Tapua, e Enã,

versos.hebraico: יַרְמוּת֙ וַעֲדֻלָּ֔ם שׂוֹכֹ֖ה וַעֲזֵקָֽה׃

controles.web: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
controles.kjv: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
controles.livre: Jeremote, e Adulão, Socó, e Azeca,

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁעֲרַ֨יִם֙ וַעֲדִיתַ֔יִם וְהַגְּדֵרָ֖ה וּגְדֵרֹתָ֑יִם עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
controles.livre: E Saaraim, e Aditaim, e Gederá, e Gederotaim; catorze cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: צְנָ֥ן וַחֲדָשָׁ֖ה וּמִגְדַּל־גָּֽד׃

controles.web: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,
controles.kjv: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal–gad,
controles.livre: Zenã, e Hadasa, e Migdal-Gade,

versos.hebraico: וְדִלְעָ֥ן וְהַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וְיָקְתְאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
controles.kjv: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
controles.livre: E Dileã, e Mispá, e Jocteel,

versos.hebraico: לָכִ֥ישׁ וּבָצְקַ֖ת וְעֶגְלֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
controles.kjv: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
controles.livre: Laquis, e Bozcate, e Eglom,

versos.hebraico: וְכַבּ֥וֹן וְלַחְמָ֖ס וְכִתְלִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,
controles.kjv: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
controles.livre: E Cabom, e Laamás, e Quitilis,

versos.hebraico: וּגְדֵר֕וֹת בֵּית־דָּג֥וֹן וְנַעֲמָ֖ה וּמַקֵּדָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

controles.web: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Gederoth, Beth–dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
controles.livre: E Gederote, Bete-Dagom, e Naamá, e Maquedá; dezesseis cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנָ֥ה וָעֶ֖תֶר וְעָשָֽׁן׃

controles.web: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
controles.kjv: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
controles.livre: Libna, e Eter, e Asã,

versos.hebraico: וְיִפְתָּ֥ח וְאַשְׁנָ֖ה וּנְצִֽיב׃

controles.web: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
controles.kjv: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
controles.livre: E Iftá, e Asná, e Nezibe,

versos.hebraico: וּקְעִילָ֥ה וְאַכְזִ֖יב וּמָֽרֵאשָׁ֑ה עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
controles.livre: E Queila, e Aczibe, e Maressa; nove cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: עֶקְר֥וֹן וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;
controles.kjv: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
controles.livre: Ecrom com suas vilas e suas aldeias:

versos.hebraico: מֵעֶקְר֖וֹן וָיָ֑מָּה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־יַ֥ד אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.
controles.kjv: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
controles.livre: Desde Ecrom até o mar, todas as que estão à costa de Asdode com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: אַשְׁדּ֞וֹד בְּנוֹתֶ֣יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֗יהָ עַזָּ֥ה בְּנוֹתֶ֥יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֖יהָ עַד־נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהַיָּ֥ם הגבול וּגְבֽוּל׃ס

controles.web: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.
controles.kjv: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
controles.livre: Asdode com suas vilas e suas aldeias: Gaza com suas vilas e suas aldeias até o rio do Egito, e o grande mar com seus termos.

versos.hebraico: וּבָהָ֑ר שָׁמִ֥יר וְיַתִּ֖יר וְשׂוֹכֹֽה׃

controles.web: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
controles.kjv: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
controles.livre: E nas montanhas, Samir, e Jatir, e Sucote,

versos.hebraico: וְדַנָּ֥ה וְקִרְיַת־סַנָּ֖ה הִ֥יא דְבִֽר׃

controles.web: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),
controles.kjv: And Dannah, and Kirjath–sannah, which is Debir,
controles.livre: E Dana, e Quiriate-Saná, que é Debir,

versos.hebraico: וַעֲנָ֥ב וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖ה וְעָנִֽים׃

controles.web: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
controles.kjv: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
controles.livre: E Anabe, e Estemo, e Anim,

versos.hebraico: וְגֹ֥שֶׁן וְחֹלֹ֖ן וְגִלֹ֑ה עָרִ֥ים אַֽחַת־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
controles.livre: E Gósen, e Holom, e Gilo; onze cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: אֲרַ֥ב וְרוּמָ֖ה וְאֶשְׁעָֽן׃

controles.web: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
controles.kjv: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
controles.livre: Arabe, e Dumá, e Esã,

versos.hebraico: וינים וּבֵית־תַּפּ֖וּחַ וַאֲפֵֽקָה׃

controles.web: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
controles.kjv: And Janum, and Beth–tappuah, and Aphekah,
controles.livre: E Janim, e Bete-Tapua, e Afeca,

versos.hebraico: וְחֻמְטָ֗ה וְקִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן וְצִיעֹ֑ר עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

controles.web: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (the same is Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Humtah, and Kirjath–arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
controles.livre: E Hunta, e Quiriate-Arba, que é Hebrom, e Zior; nove cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: מָע֥וֹן׀ כַּרְמֶ֖ל וָזִ֥יף וְיוּטָּֽה׃

controles.web: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,
controles.kjv: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
controles.livre: Maom, Carmelo, e Zife, e Jutá,

versos.hebraico: וְיִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיָקְדְעָ֖ם וְזָנֽוֹחַ׃

controles.web: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
controles.kjv: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
controles.livre: E Jezreel, Jocdeão, e Zanoa,

versos.hebraico: הַקַּ֖יִן גִּבְעָ֣ה וְתִמְנָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
controles.livre: Caim, Gibeá, e Timna; dez cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: חַלְח֥וּל בֵּֽית־צ֖וּר וּגְדֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
controles.kjv: Halhul, Beth–zur, and Gedor,
controles.livre: Halul, e Bete-Zur, e Gedor,

versos.hebraico: וּמַעֲרָ֥ת וּבֵית־עֲנ֖וֹת וְאֶלְתְּקֹ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Maarath, and Beth–anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
controles.livre: E Maarate, e Bete-Anote, e Eltecom; seis cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: קִרְיַת־בַּ֗עַל הִ֛יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים וְהָֽרַבָּ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

controles.web: Kiriath Baal (the same is Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: Kirjath–baal, which is Kirjath–jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
controles.livre: Quriate-Baal, que é Quriate-Jearim, e Rabá; duas cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר בֵּ֚ית הָעֲרָבָ֔ה מִדִּ֖ין וּסְכָכָֽה׃

controles.web: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,
controles.kjv: In the wilderness, Beth–arabah, Middin, and Secacah,
controles.livre: No deserto, Bete-Arabá, Midim, e Secacá,

versos.hebraico: וְהַנִּבְשָׁ֥ן וְעִיר־הַמֶּ֖לַח וְעֵ֣ין גֶּ֑דִי עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.
controles.kjv: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En–gedi; six cities with their villages.
controles.livre: E Nibsã, e a cidade do sal, e En-Gedi; seis cidades com suas aldeias.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי֙ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹֽא־יוכלו בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֖ה לְהֽוֹרִישָׁ֑ם וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַיְבוּסִ֜י אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

controles.web: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
controles.kjv: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
controles.livre: Mas aos jebuseus que habitavam em Jerusalém, os filhos de Judá não os puderam desarraigar; antes restaram os jebuseus em Jerusalém com os filhos de Judá, até hoje.
